question: Can a learned matcher use five complete, unsegmented demonstrations to improve exact closed-loop task completion on unseen programs, beyond strong simple automatic alignment and flat controls?
information: At each query decision only local front/left/right clearance and marker presence, the query's own action/observation prefix, and five other demonstrations with their own actions, local observations and terminal STOP. No correspondence tags, first-arrival signal, program text, target action/length/goal grid, absolute map, step-to-step labels or target simulator search. Input order and the demonstrated ends are inherent in the data. The policy itself selects every target action including STOP.
development: Pinned MSR-style validation mirror reused as source for within-study training. Group exact space-joined program token SHA256s. Development holdout iff int(hash[:8],16)%5==0, all remaining groups for training. Historical pilot work used this bank, so in-domain holdout is only new to these fits. Every eligible original record supplies six worlds in source order. Sample a training code uniformly, record uniformly within that code, and a uniform query world with the five remaining trajectories as supports.
external: New prospectively selected LEAPS corpus, source registration karel_unaligned_source_20261120.json when named by source owner or recorded equivalent. Exclude exact overlaps against all development codes and all earlier external study codes; no substitutions. All six trajectories must pass native validation; include episodes with no primitives/moves. Evaluate each of the six as query against the other five. The fixed subset is a cross-corpus test under a related Karel grammar. Do not treat token disjointness as semantic disjointness.
model: Shared 32-dimensional causal GRU encoding current local observation and previous primitive (BOS at start). Project hidden and current observation jointly to a normalized 24-dimensional vector. For every target step compare its vector with every support position by scaled cosine similarity, starting from equal donor prior mass. Softmax scores vote for observed support actions including STOP. Only next-action imitation loss on target trajectories is given; no time-pair targets. Zero probability for undemonstrated labels is smoothed by 0.001/6 inside training loss. Same-parameter centroid comparator compresses all support representations for each action (each donor contributes equal prior weight) into one normalized centroid and votes by scaled cosine plus log prior. Nontrained random encoder seed 17, and fixed within-donor scrambling of support labels against learned retrieval keys at seed 17, probe weight learning and position use.
fitting: Both metric models trained separately for 1200 minibatches of 16 sampled programs at seeds 17,29,43. Same episode streams within seed. Adam lr 0.003, global gradient norm cap 5, fixed final weights, no checkpoint selection, no search and no external data for fit. Loss averages valid query decisions within an episode then averages episodes. Report losses, training-label support coverage, and parameter counts. Primary neural performance averages the three single-seed policies' outcomes, with no action ensembling.
rollout: Hold start, five supports, local observations and cap constant. Execute in strict source-specific simulator until STOP, invalid primitive or min(512,max(32,2*max support primitive length+8)) primitive actions (STOP may be issued at the cap). A successful STOP must reproduce the complete recorded final world including walls, markers, pose and heading. Crash or cap counts as failure. Report all targets, duplicated codes combined equally by exact program, with outcomes separate by corpus.
primary_decision: On external data require average retrieval minus the best of ALL simple policies >=0.02 absolute, lower endpoint of 5000 coupled whole-program percentile bootstrap draws (minimum across all simple policy contrasts per draw) >0, and each retrieval seed above the strongest simple aggregate. Seed 20261120. For an individual-position matching interpretation additionally require advantage over the trained action-centroid control and positive matched-seed retrieval over scrambled labels. Report individual strengths and paired discordances. No causal interpretation of attention peaks. Stop this implementation on failure instead of tuning the external bank. A positive is a candidate needing truly separate confirmatory tasks.
secondary: Report diagnostic exact endpoints among targets with at least two distinct primitive traces across supports; distinguish evaluation on empty target traces. Report crash/cap. Class-centroid and random/scrambled diagnostics do not alter primary threshold. Independent corpus and within-domain results remain separate.
compute: School CPU allocation only for training, policy inference and evaluation. No paid compute, GPU, automation or external messages. No changes to evaluation after outcomes.
